help.title: How to Use Gradify CSS

gradientType.title: 1. Choose Gradient Type
gradientType.description: Select between Linear, Radial, or Conic gradient types. Each type creates a different visual effect.

adjustAngle.title: 2. Adjust Angle/Position
adjustAngle.description: For linear gradients, adjust the angle. For radial and conic gradients, set the center position and shape.

colorStops.title: 3. Add Color Stops
colorStops.description: Click 'Add Color Stop' to add more colors. Drag the slider to adjust the position of each color. Click the color box to change the color.

preview.title: 4. Preview & Copy
preview.description: See the live preview of your gradient. When you're happy with the result, click 'Copy CSS' to copy the code to your clipboard.

history.title: 5. History
history.description: Every time you copy a gradient, it's saved to your history. Access the History tab to reuse previous gradients.

inspiration.title: 6. Get Inspired
inspiration.description: Visit the Inspiration tab for pre-made gradient presets. Click any preset to load it in the Creator.

help.tip: Pro Tip: Use the randomize button to generate random gradients for inspiration!
